map.机动中总载荷因数 n≈√(1+(a/g)²)（平飞转弯时水平向心分量叠加重力），: Total load factor in manoeuvring n≈√(1+(a/g)²) (in a level turn the horizontal centripetal component adds to gravity), with n≈1+a/g as a small-angle approximation. This tool computes the pure centripetal component a and pairs with the slope and load factor tools.
map.机动飞行或地面转弯时，由速度 v 与转弯半径 r 算向心加速度 a=v²/r。: In manoeuvring flight or a ground turn, compute the centripetal acceleration a=v²/r from speed v and turn radius r.

map.算，汽车、列车、飞机地面滑行的转弯都用同一公式。只是航空更关注对乘员 g 感受与: It works out the same: cars, trains and aircraft all use the same formula for ground turns. Aviation cares more about the g sensation on occupants and structure, while ground vehicles care more about side slip and track width.

map.：速度 v=100 m/s、转弯半径 r=500 m，向心加速度 a=v²/r=: : speed v=100 m/s, turn radius r=500 m, centripetal acceleration a=v²/r=10000/500=20 m/s²≈2.04g. Occupants feel about 2g of load, so both comfort and structure need assessment.
